known.via: English Wikipedia "Paso Robles Highlands District AVA"

climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: A district of canyons and highlands inside the Paso Robles AVA, east of Creston. At 60,300 acres it is the second-largest in Paso Robles, reaching from near Shandon to the base of the La Panza Range.
